user.title: Tapo C260 Face Recognition
user.description: Enter the camera IP, username and Cloud Password. Login is tested when the camera is added.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tapo C260
reauth_confirm.description: Camera {host} rejected the login. Enter the username and Cloud Password again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Tapo C260.

abort.no_unknown_faces: No unknown Face IDs have been discovered.

menu_options.add_unknown: Add person from unknown Face ID

add_face.title: Add Face ID
add_face.description: Enter the Face ID the camera detected and the matching name.

edit_face.title: Edit Face ID / name
edit_face.description: Choose the current mapping, then enter the new Face ID and name.

polling.title: Polling / Dedup
polling.description: Adjust how often events are read, and dedup.

add_unknown.title: Add person from unknown Face ID
add_unknown.description: Pick a Face ID the camera has detected, then give it a name.

sidebar.title: Show in sidebar
sidebar.description: Show or hide the Tapo C260 Face Manager entry in the Home Assistant sidebar. When hidden, open the page at [/tapo_c260_face](/tapo_c260_face).

data_description.show_sidebar: When off, the page is still reachable at /tapo_c260_face. With several cameras, the sidebar entry is shown if at least one camera has it enabled.
data_description.sidebar_title: Leave empty for "Tapo C260 Face Manager". Max 40 characters. With several cameras the first enabled camera (by name) that sets a name wins.

retention.title: Storage limits
retention.description: Statistics and strangers older than this many days are removed automatically; the stranger list keeps at most the number below (least recently seen are dropped first). Applied immediately on save.

error.invalid_face_id: Face ID must contain digits only.

authentication_failed.message: The Tapo C260 rejected the login. Check the username and Cloud Password.
